We need to determine charges based on facts. The case: virtual VAT invoices (增值税专用发票) fabricated without real transaction, for 6250 tons of corn, 100 invoices, amount 9,968,750 yuan, tax 1,146,847 yuan. They collected fee 125,000 yuan. This is classic "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票". Also possibly "逃税" because they evaded tax? But the main charge is virtual VAT invoice. In previous examples, they used that label for similar cases. Also maybe "经济犯" but not needed. The list includes "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票". So answer that.

Check if any other charges: maybe "受贿" or "单位行贿"? The facts involve a manager (侯某) and Wu1, but they are not public officials; they are private persons. So not bribery. It's a tax crime.

Thus final answer: [罪名]虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票<eoa>
